block_health.purpose: Calculates block-level agronomic yield gap and production risk score

formulas.expected_yield: median(peers with Plant_Age_Years in [age - 2, age + 2] and Block_ID != current_block, count >= 3)

limitations: Stepwise discontinuous risk score (20, 40, 60, 75, 90) rather than continuous interpolation
Evaluates only annual yield for latest year (2024)
Peer cohort matching depends strictly on plant age (+/- 2 years) across 42 blocks

nutrient_diagnostics.purpose: Analyzes foliar macronutrients and micronutrients to detect nutrient deficiencies

formulas.sampling_selection: Latest valid Leaf_Sampling_Year per block where Leaf_Data_Available == True
formulas.reference_thresholds: Low = Q25, High = Q75 of historical distinct block/sample-year observations
formulas.classification: value < Q25 -> LOW; value > Q75 -> HIGH; else NORMAL
formulas.low_nutrient_count: sum(status == LOW for available nutrients in [N, P, K, Ca, Mg, B])

limitations: Reference ranges are empirical sample quartiles (Q25/Q75) from the estate dataset, not absolute physiological standards
Boron (B_ppm) is unmeasured in 11 of 42 blocks (represented as NO_DATA)

dris_prescription.purpose: Computes DRIS nutritional balance indices and ranks limiting nutrients

formulas.dris_indices: Beaufils dual-ratio standard score calculation against high-yield reference population

limitations: Only 31 of 42 blocks have DRIS survey records available for latest year
Requires full 5 macronutrient panel (N, P, K, Ca, Mg)

weather_impact.purpose: Evaluates correlation and dataset-level weather stress indicators

formulas.weather_stress: Observations in outer quartiles (< Q25 or > Q75) for 5 weather variables
formulas.stress_count: Sum of extreme weather months in the year

findings.reason: All 42 blocks contain identical repeated monthly weather measurements from an estate-wide weather station

weather_impact.status_in_risk_engine: EXCLUDED from block-level scoring; marked as 'Unavailable / Not integrated' for block discrimination
limitations: Cannot distinguish microclimate variations between blocks without block-specific weather stations or IoT sensors

soil_evidence.purpose: Reports available soil chemical and physical properties
soil_evidence.handling_policy: Sparse observations must NOT be blindly imputed or fabricated; reported as 'observed' where sampled, 'unavailable' for unsampled blocks
soil_evidence.status_in_risk_engine: Excluded from primary weighting to prevent biasing 35 unsampled blocks; reported as qualitative agronomic evidence

multi_source_risk.purpose: Aggregates independent evidence components into a composite block risk score
multi_source_risk.weight_renormalization: valid_weight = sum(w_i for available components); Multi_Source_Risk_Score = sum(Component_i * w_i) / valid_weight
hardcoded_values: Base weights (0.40, 0.25, 0.15) explicitly defined as design choice
Risk level cutoffs (40, 70) defined as management decision thresholds

high_production_classification.rule: Maximum FFB production for each Block + Year is the High Production threshold
high_production_classification.status: Operationalized via monthly peak capacity ratio and peer-relative yield expectation

api_endpoints_audited./api/health: Reports backend status and file presence
needed_standardized_endpoints: GET /api/risk/<Block_ID> (Canonical single-block risk object with decoupled evidence flags)
GET /api/risk/summary (Plantation-level risk score distribution and summary statistics)

overall_audit_conclusion.data_leakage: VERIFIED (No target leakage; age peer comparison excludes current block)
overall_audit_conclusion.weather_status: UNAVAILABLE for block discrimination (estate repeated averages; excluded from score)
overall_audit_conclusion.soil_status: SPARSE (7 of 42 blocks; qualitative only, no blind imputation)
overall_audit_conclusion.rgb_and_ms_status: SPATIALLY UNMAPPED (zero spatial overlap; strictly decoupled from block records)
